name: playful
description: Desire for a positive stimulating social experience.

variations.name: play to bond
variations.description: Play can be a social bonding experience.

variations.name: play as an escape
variations.description: It may help you forget about anxieties for a while.

variations.name: play as practice
variations.description: Play may improve skills that may be useful in another context.

commentaries.quote: Being 'playful' can mean light-hearted bonding activities like like games and pillow fights, or more serious social adventures like dancing or sports.
People are generally more playful with friends, and play can be a bonding experience.
Play can be a way to improve skills in a safe environment.

conditions: Self experiences a desire for an entertaining social activity.
Self experiences a desire to interact with important others in a way that practices key skills.
